id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

latestAlert.description: Latest alert raised for this {@link ProtectionLoop}.

highHighThreshold.description: High threshold which indicates a potential problem with the sensor.

highThreshold.description: Threshold representing the upper bound of sensor values indicating normal operations.

lowThreshold.description: Threshold representing the lower bound of sensor values indicating normal operations.

lowLowThreshold.description: Low threshold which indicates a potential problem with the sensor.

currentHealth.description: The latest evaluation of protection loop health.

highRiskCount.description:
Overrides the {@link ReliabilityProtectionLoopConfig#highRiskPercentage} such that this {@link ProtectionLoop}
will be considered high risk at this count of sensor issues and above.

totalUnhealthySensors.description: It calculates total unhealty alerts from the latest {@link ProtectionLoopAlert}.

sensorDeviationThreshold.description: The threshold of sensor deviation that should be hit for this

totalSensors.description: It calculates total sensors in the {@link ProtectionLoop}.

overallAsset.description:
The overall asset for the {@link ProtectionLoop} defined as the lowest asset in the hierarchy tree
which is an ancestor to all of the sensors in the {@link #sensorRelations}.

highLowLookbackPeriod.description: The lookback period for evaluating the high and low metric logic for the sensors in the protection loop. Overrides

healthHistory.description: A history of unhealthy sensors and overall risk level for the protection loop.

totalFunctionalSensors.description: It calculates total sensors without an alert.

openAlerts.description: The open {@link ProtectionLoopAlert}s on this {@link ProtectionLoop}.

mediumRiskCount.description:
Overrides the {@link ReliabilityProtectionLoopConfig#mediumRiskPercentage} such that this {@link ProtectionLoop}
will be considered medium risk at this count of sensor issues and above.

risk.description: It returns the risk status of the latest alert {@link ProtectionLoopHealthHistory} raised.

parentAsset.description:
The parent asset of the protection loop which is the {@link #overallAsset} when specified or the parent asset
of the first sensor otherwise.

title:
Represents of group of redundant sensors that are monitoring the same process and simultaneously having their
health evaluated as a group.
name: ProtectionLoop
